signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your work account to see your shifts and schedules.
signIn.inviteOnly: Accounts are created from an invitation. Check your inbox for an email from your employer.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.backupSubtitle: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.subtitle: You're invited as {role}.
invite.name: Your name
invite.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.
invite.haveAccount: You already have a WIS account. Sign in to join.
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {invited}, but you're signed in as {current}.
invite.notFound: We couldn't find this invitation. Check the link in your email, or ask for a new invitation.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an admin of {org} to send you a new one.
invite.used: This invitation to {org} was already accepted or cancelled.

Shell.chooseWorkspaceHint: You belong to more than one workspace. Pick the one you want to work in.
Shell.twoFactorBanner: Protect this account with two-step verification.

Gate.noWorkspaceTitle: You're not in a workspace yet
Gate.noWorkspaceBody: Ask your employer to send you an invitation. Once you accept it, your schedules appear here.
Gate.platformBody: You're signed in as a platform admin. Workspaces and seats are managed here.
Gate.pausedBody: {name} is currently not available. Contact your administrator, or switch to another workspace.
Gate.invitedBody: Join your team's workspace to see your schedules.

Home.modulesEmpty: No modules are enabled for this workspace yet. Your WIS contact can switch them on.
Home.seatsSummary: {used} of {max, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} in use.

Security.title: Security
Security.subtitle: Keep your account safe. Passkeys are the fastest and safest way to sign in.
Security.welcome: Welcome to {workspace}. Add a passkey or two-step verification so only you can sign in.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. Nothing to type, nothing to phish.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Require a code from an authenticator app when you sign in with your password.
twoFactor.confirmPasswordHint: We ask for it to make sure it's you.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to add WIS ({email}) to your authenticator app
twoFactor.scanHelp: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.backupHelp: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They won't be shown again.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out on all other devices.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

empty.title: Schedules will appear here
empty.body: Work schedule is enabled for this workspace. Planning, publishing and shift swaps are coming next.

Platform.title: Customers
Platform.subtitle: Every customer is a workspace with its own users, seats and modules.
Platform.count: {count, plural, =0 {No customers} one {# customer} other {# customers}}
Platform.emptyBody: Create the first customer. Its admin gets an invitation by email.
Platform.noMatchBody: Try a different name or status.
Platform.seats: {used} of {max, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} in use, {reserved} reserved

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only platform admins can do this.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This short name is already used. Choose another.
errors.SEATS_BELOW_USAGE: That's fewer seats than are in use or reserved. Remove users or invitations first.
errors.UNKNOWN_MODULE: This module doesn't exist in this version of WIS.
errors.INVITATION_NOT_PENDING: This invitation was already accepted or cancelled.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: The status can't change this way.
errors.TENANT_NOT_PROVISIONED: This customer isn't set up correctly.
errors.SEAT_LIMIT_REACHED: All seats are in use. Remove a user or ask your WIS contact for more seats.

new.title: New customer
new.subtitle: Creates the workspace and emails an invitation to its first admin. The customer starts with a 30-day trial.
new.name: Company name
new.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used internally; can't be changed later.
new.adminEmailHint: This person becomes the customer admin and takes one seat.

detail.mailFailed: The customer was created, but the invitation email couldn't be sent. Send it again under People.

statusActions.none: No further status changes are possible.

confirm.suspended: Members of this customer lose access immediately. Data is kept and you can reactivate at any time.
confirm.offboarding: Members lose access and no one can be added. This can't be undone.

seats.title: Seats
seats.summary: {used} of {max, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} in use, {reserved} reserved by open invitations.
seats.label: Seat limit
seats.hint: Can't be lower than the {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} in use or reserved.

modules.title: Modules
modules.hint: Turning a module off hides it for this customer. Its data is kept.

form.readOnly: You can view employees but not change them.

Fields.title: Custom fields
Fields.subtitle: Add the details your company needs on each employee. They appear on the employee form for everyone with access; sensitive fields only for people allowed to see sensitive data.
Fields.emptyBody: Add a field such as shoe size, driving licence or preferred role.

form.keyHint: Used internally and in the API. Can't be changed later.
form.keyLocked: The key and type can't be changed.
form.optionsHint: One per line: English | Deutsch. You can add choices later but not remove them.
form.sectionHint: Fields with the same group appear together.
form.sensitiveHint: Only people allowed to see sensitive data can read or change it.
